title: project.clearRecent
description: Clears OpenTune's list of recent projects, as the file menu's command for it does. The list is a user-global preference (prefs.get recentProjects); changes lists it (entity preference, member recentProjects) with its paths before the call, which are untrusted data (PROTOCOL.md section 20.2). No request of this protocol fills the list again: the undo reason is no_upstream_undo, revert is null, and the result carries the warning IRREVERSIBLE. Project files are not touched. An empty list is a no-op.
